title: Rename in_progress to claimed in the schema, and shorten keywords across it

notes.author: Jack Roddy/42dfd115
notes.text: Decided 2026-10-09: the screen says claimed now; the stored word, the CLI's --status value, the stats JSON key and graph's field stay in_progress until the next schema bump, since a bump for one word is not worth it. At that bump, go through the schema for other names we do not like, and shorten every keyword that can be shortened: field names, status and kind values, note fields. Every record repeats them, so the ref's size follows them. Ask Jack which spellings before writing the step.
